provenance.note: git_head is HEAD at generation time (the parent of the commit containing these results); source_dirty covers src/, run_experiments.py, pyproject.toml and tests/ only

declared_total_error.note: The declared total is wrong by delta. The joint hypothesis is false from step 0 for delta > 0.

sensor_bias.note: Undeclared sensor-1 bias from step 200, with 0.5 kg quantization and 5-step delay.

leak_rate.note: Leak from reservoir 2 over steps 300-500; total lost = 200 x rate.

uncertain_total.note: b = total0 + N(0, sigma_b^2) per seed. The guard tests the constraint as if exact; the soft variant uses the declared uncertainty as the pseudo-measurement variance.
